title: shadPS4 0.5.0: official development build
summary: shadPS4 published 0.5.0 on December 25, 2024. The release record documents an official development build for the PlayStation 4 emulator project.

blocks.text: The shadPS4 project published version 0.5.0 on December 25, 2024. GitHub marks this entry as a release; this distinction is preserved here so the build is not mistaken for a different update channel.
The official notes highlight the following changes: Ajm support. Videodec implementation. Fix border color. Rewrite pthread emulation.
